senses.gloss:
उष्मन् उष् + मन्, m.
 1. Heat, MBh. 9, 13969.
 2. Ardour, Pañc. ii. d. 67; Śiś. 9, 85.
 3. Hot moisture, Man. 1, 45.
 --Comp.

ऊष्मन् ऊष्मन् (= उष्मन्).
 1. Heat, MBh. 14, 468.
 2. A name comprising the sibilants and ह्, Bhāg. P. 3, 12, 47.

ऊष्मप ऊष्मप, i. e. ऊष्मन्-प (vb. 1. पा).
 I. adj. Drinking the steam of food only, MBh. 13, 646.
 II. m. pl. The name of a class of Pitṛs or Manes, MBh. 2, 341.
